name: After § 10
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
part_text: 10a. Expresses deep concern about the consequences of mass migration by Afghans for the freedom and security of women and girls across Europe; emphasises that direct technical cooperation between the EU and its Member States and Afghanistan is a prerequisite for the effective return of Afghans from EU Member States;
